business.parcels.offToDoor: It comes back to {place} as a driver’s load, at the driver’s price. Say the most you will pay: we suggest {most}.
business.parcels.calledOffDoor: {id} comes back to your place as a driver’s load.
business.parcels.f.toPlaceSub: Via the shop nearest it, then a driver’s load to the door
business.parcels.f.most: The most you pay a driver for the last leg ({currency})
business.parcels.f.mostHint: From {via} to your place, at the driver’s own price — never above this. We suggest {suggested}. Paid from your balance when a driver takes it.
business.parcels.gap.most: the most you pay for the last leg
business.parcels.stage.doorShort: Top up for the last leg
business.parcels.fact.receivesIt: Who receives it at your place
business.parcels.stage.comingToYou: On its way to your place
business.parcels.door.title: To {place}:
business.parcels.door.waiting: once it is at {via}, a driver is asked to bring it, for at most {most}.
business.parcels.door.short: it is at {via}, and your balance does not hold the {most} its last leg may cost. Top up, then post it — or collect it at the shop with its code.
business.parcels.door.posted: load {code} waits for a driver, at most {most}. Collected at the shop with its code instead, the load is withdrawn.
business.parcels.door.taken: {name} took load {code} and collects it at {via}.
business.parcels.door.handed: {name} has it, on the way to {place}.
business.parcels.door.collected: collected at {via} with its code; the last leg was withdrawn.
business.parcels.door.postedNow: {id}: a driver is asked to bring it.
business.post.bar: Posting a load · goes public at the last step
business.post.barOrder: Ordering a load · sent at the last step
business.post.l.carrier: The open board, where carriers find it — or a carrier you have a contract with, who plans it in.
business.post.boardOnly: It goes on the open board: any checked carrier can take it, or send you a price.
business.post.l.route: From one of your saved places to another — or to a business, by the code it gave you.
business.post.l.goods: Carriers read exactly this on the board, and it goes on the consignment note.
business.post.l.goodsContract: Your carrier plans from exactly this, and it goes on the consignment note.
business.post.l.when: The day it is collected, and the hours it can be delivered. Both can be left empty.
business.post.l.value: How a carrier’s price is agreed, and what you declare on the consignment note.
business.post.l.valueContract: What you declare on the consignment note. The price is your contract’s.
business.post.l.day: What the driver is told, and who to ask for at the door. All of it can be left empty.
business.post.l.check: Nothing is posted yet, and no carrier sees any of it. Change any part here: it goes on the board only when you tap Post the load.
business.post.l.checkContract: Nothing is sent yet. Change any part here: it goes to your carrier only when you tap the button at the end.
business.post.keptHint: What you answer is kept on this phone as you go, for three days, until the load is posted.
business.post.stillNeeds: Some answers are still needed before it can go: each is said under its part, with Change to go to it.
business.post.nothingGiven: Nothing given here — all of it can be left empty.
business.post.seeBoardNow: Once posted it is on the open board at once. Every carrier on SeeBuyGet can read it there, and one whose vehicle can carry it {how}.
business.post.seeBoardFrom: Once posted it waits, seen by no carrier, until 08:00 on {day}; then it goes on the open board. Every carrier on SeeBuyGet can read it there, and one whose vehicle can carry it {how}.
business.post.howNegotiate: can send you a price — nobody takes it until you accept one
business.post.howInstant: can take it at the board price
business.post.seeContract: Once sent, only {fleet} sees it: it goes to their orders for {day}, never onto the open board.
business.post.seeCover: Only a carrier whose insurance SeeBuyGet has checked can take it.
business.post.seeReceiver: {name} sees it coming in, without your price.
business.post.v.asSoon: As soon as a carrier can
business.post.need.deliverOn: Say which day it must arrive.
business.post.need.deliverOnGone: That day has gone: an order is for today or later.
business.post.need.pickupOnGone: That day has gone: choose another, or leave it empty for as soon as a carrier can.
business.post.need.volumeM3: Give the space in cubic metres: more than nothing, and at most 150.
business.post.temp.title: The temperature it is kept at
business.post.temp.hint: Chilled goods: between 2 and 8. Frozen: -18 or colder — say between -25 and -18. Left empty, it is kept between 2 and 8 °C. Only a refrigerated or insulated truck is offered it; its driver logs the temperature on the way, and you are told if it leaves the range.
business.post.need.tempRange: Give both, the lowest and the highest — or leave both empty to keep it between 2 and 8 °C.
business.post.need.tempBounds: A temperature here is between -30 and 30 °C.
business.post.need.tempOrder: The lowest must be below the highest.
business.post.v.tempUsual: 2 °C and 8 °C — none given, so the usual for chilled goods
business.post.doneBoard: It is on the open board now.
business.post.doneNegotiate: Carriers can send you prices; they come to the load, and nobody takes it until you accept one.
business.post.doneInstant: The first carrier whose vehicle can carry it takes it at the board price.
business.post.doneFrom: It waits, seen by no carrier, until 08:00 on {day}; then it goes on the open board.
business.post.doneContract: Sent to {fleet}, to arrive {day}. It is in their orders, not on the open board.
business.post.keptLine: Kept on this phone since {when}: {what}. Nothing of it is posted yet.
business.post.keptNothing: nothing said yet of what it is
business.post.carryOn: Carry on with the load you started
business.manifest.title: Border manifest — Moyale
business.manifest.why: One document for customs, the checkpoints and tax officers at the Moyale post, in English and Amharic. It is the carrier’s transport document: your declarations are lodged in each country’s own system, and their numbers go here.
business.manifest.complete: Complete: the goods may be taken over.
business.manifest.incomplete: Not complete: the goods are not taken over until it is.
business.manifest.copies: {n, plural, one {# copy frozen so far, with its fingerprint} other {# copies frozen so far, each with its fingerprint}}
business.manifest.etims: eTIMS invoice number of the zero-rated export
business.manifest.refsHint: From you or your clearing agent: the export number before pickup, the import number before the goods reach the post.
business.manifest.saved: Saved. Given after pickup, a new copy of the manifest is frozen with them.
business.parcels.f.receiverName: Receiver’s name, as on their ID (optional)
business.parcels.emailCode.title: The collection code by email
business.parcels.emailCode.note: Only for parcels that give the receiver’s email and name. The shop then also checks the name on their ID, so a forwarded email alone hands nothing over.
business.loads.f.receiverNote: Who receives it, if you know: once a driver has the load, its delivery code reaches them in the Send app on this number, or by email. Without the code the driver cannot mark it delivered.
business.loads.f.receiverName: Receiver’s name, as on their ID
business.loads.codeNote: The receiver gives it to the driver at the handover.
business.loads.arrivedSaid: You said it arrived: the driver may deliver without the code.
